name: char_pixel_art
description: Converts input character renders/photos into crisp 16-bit retro game pixel art sprites using Pixel-Art LoRA.

PARAM_PROMPT.default: masterpiece, best quality, pixel art, 16-bit retro game sprite, pixelated, 32-color palette

PARAM_NEGATIVE_PROMPT.default: blurry, smooth, photorealistic, 3d render, vector art, noise

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, missing limbs, extra limbs, cropped, text, watermark, signature, jpeg artifacts, blurry
